While profitability metrics show deterioration, the explanations (infrastructure investments, store expansions) logically account for this. The financial position changes (asset growth, equity decline, debt reduction) are presented consistently. There is no self-contradiction, logical gap, organizational problem, or unnecessary repetition that materially reduces clarity. All relationships between figures and explanations follow logically within the text itself.
